svg.title: Sealed object: a name and a note
svg.desc: A dark-mode mockup of OnetimePad's sealed block. Today's block is drawn first. The proposed block carries a name before the mechanical excerpt, as MY_API_KEY=ghp_4kQ9…e0H5jK. The bottom row has three pointer zones: the name copies the name, the value copies the decrypted contents, the equals sign between them copies name=value decrypted; each names its consequence in the size class's seat while hovered. A note is written in the page's own surface inside a popover the block's measure wide, expanded with diagonal arrows at its bottom right.
svg.text: Sealed object: a name and a note
Left: today's block, then the proposed states. Right: the three copy zones, the object's menu, the note. Drawn at 2×; lengths in points from SealedBlockLayout.swift; dark appearance.
TODAY · POINTER OVER IT, OR SELECTED
··· opens the menu (D-40). A plain click only selects the block.
Top row unchanged: state first. The name is set in the excerpt's face, semibold, then = and the
mechanical excerpt. 'note' in the metadata seat says a note exists and is the doorway to it.
The seat where the size class sits says what a click does. Nothing moves; the name is ambient text.
'decrypted' names the boundary before the click (Law 0001, legibility). The value zone is a handle in
D-29's sense: a named declassification on the object itself, never on the ordinary copy path.
The whole line lights up; one click copies MY_API_KEY=<plaintext>, ready for a .env or a shell.
copied decrypted contents · small. the clipboard clears in 60 seconds.
The zone wears ember for a beat, then rests. The page's line reads as it does today, with the size class.
NAMING · 'NAME…' IN THE MENU, OR DOUBLE-CLICK THE ROW
↩ names it · esc leaves it unnamed
An inline field in the name's seat, as an IDE renames a symbol. Return commits, Esc cancels, no
dialog (D-14). Rename… edits it in place. The name is page-owned text like a title, never payload.
THE THREE ZONES OF THE BOTTOM ROW
Each zone is also a menu item (D-10). Outside the row a click selects the block, as today. The = zone is
the glyph plus a few points either side; the name and value zones are their own glyph runs.
THE OBJECT'S MENU · NAMED, WITH A NOTE
Unnamed: no 'Copy name' and no name=value item; 'Name…' and 'Note…' stand in for Rename… and Edit
note…. Order holds D-41's: egress first, the object's own words next, removal last behind a separator.
THE NOTE · CLICK 'NOTE', OR NOTE… IN THE MENU
Mint a new one at github.com, Settings
The page's own writing surface in a popover the block's measure wide: same face, same keys, the
same undo. Ink, never sealed; it rides with the object through cut, paste and clone, not in the ledger.
THE NOTE, EXPANDED · ⇧ESC OR THE ARROWS
Mint a new one at github.com, Settings
Then seal the new value with ⇧⌘V over
this block and update CI's secret.
Fills the card's content area, as the page's own expand does. The arrows keep the bottom right corner
and contract the note back into the popover there, as Zed's commit field does. Esc does the same.
Not a decision record. Reopens D-40 (a plain click only selects) for the bottom row, and adds menu items beside D-41's.
